name: Blob's Adventure
summary:
Blob is a spherical space traveller. He has only got one eye, which is perhaps why he has crashed his space ship on Blobland - oh no! Blob must find a new rocket to escape... before the Alienblobs catch him!

Blob's Adventure is a tilting maze / labyrinth puzzle game. The game takes you through grassy, rocky, and icy terrains, using pick ups and physics to progress through each level. A "Mario-esque" combination of arcade platform mechanics and puzzle elements.
